svg.aria-label: Neer sign and Hawkins-Kennedy test: provoking pain under the acromion — Neer 征与 Hawkins-Kennedy 试验：在肩峰下诱发疼痛

text.aria-label: Neer sign and Hawkins-Kennedy test: provoking pain under the acromion — Neer 征与 Hawkins-Kennedy 试验：在肩峰下诱发疼痛
text.tspan: Neer sign and Hawkins-Kennedy test: provoking pain under the acromion
Neer 征与 Hawkins-Kennedy 试验：在肩峰下诱发疼痛

text.aria-label: Examiner pushes or moves — 检查者施力或移动
Patient pushes or holds — 病人用力或保持
Start or end position — 起始或结束位置
Neer sign (side view) — Neer 征（侧面观）
One hand presses down on the top of the shoulder so the scapula cannot move; — 一只手向下按住肩顶，不让肩胛骨移动；
text.tspan: One hand presses down on the top of the shoulder so the scapula cannot move;
一只手向下按住肩顶，不让肩胛骨移动；

text.aria-label: the other forcibly raises the arm. — 另一只手用力把手臂抬起来。
text.tspan: the other forcibly raises the arm.
另一只手用力把手臂抬起来。

text.aria-label: Presses down on the clavicle and acromion — 向下按住锁骨和肩峰
text.tspan: Presses down on the clavicle and acromion

text.aria-label: Neer test: repeat after a subacromial injection; positive if the pain is gone. — Neer 试验：肩峰下注射后重复这个动作，疼痛消失为阳性。
text.tspan: Neer test: repeat after a subacromial injection; positive if the pain is gone.
Neer 试验：肩峰下注射后重复这个动作，疼痛消失为阳性。

text.aria-label: Hawkins-Kennedy test (front view) — Hawkins-Kennedy 试验（前面观）
Shoulder and elbow are placed at 90° of flexion; — 检查者把肩和肘都放到屈曲 90°；
text.tspan: Shoulder and elbow are placed at 90° of flexion;
检查者把肩和肘都放到屈曲 90°；

text.aria-label: the examiner then forcibly turns the shoulder inward. — 然后用力把肩向内旋转。
text.tspan: the examiner then forcibly turns the shoulder inward.
然后用力把肩向内旋转。

text.aria-label: Start: forearm points up — 开始：前臂朝上
Upper arm points toward you — 上臂朝向读者
That is, the shoulder is flexed to 90°. — 也就是肩前屈 90°。
text.tspan: That is, the shoulder is flexed to 90°.

text.aria-label: Start, seen from the side — 起始体位（侧面观）

text.tspan: Schematic of the test position; body shapes are simplified.
检查体位示意；人体形状经过简化。
